own_solution.law: Lossless LC oscillation of charge between two capacitors: charge conservation sets equilibrium voltage V_eq = (Q1+Q2)/(C1+C2); V2 is linear in the transferred charge, which oscillates harmonically about equilibrium, so V2_max = 2 V_eq - V2(0)
assumptions: positive plates joined through the inductor

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T47FC and T3A64 say 'a small capacitor' where their apparent counterparts say 22 uF, so they do not carry the same number if meant as variants.

notes: Q1 = 4000 uC, Q2 = 200 uC; V_eq = 4200/50 = 84 V; V2 swings 20 -> 148 V. With 22 uF at 100 V in parallel with C1: C1' = 62 uF, Q1' = 6200 uC, V_eq = 6400/72 = 88.889 V, V2_max = 157.778 V. Inductance sets only the oscillation frequency (C). T94A9/T47FC refer to an earlier run only (D); T3614/T3A64 attach the capacitor to the separately powered flash unit (D).
